scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Rent was due. We tried earning money. The first business came with eggs.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Childcare exhausted Max. He decided translating a dinosaur would be easier.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Translation fees emptied our pockets. Selling pizza was our next idea.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: We ran out of pizza. Fortunately, the couch still had commercial potential.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: The couch wanted privacy. Meanwhile, our snacks needed their own security team.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: With the snacks gone, I built help. Delegation seemed mathematically sound.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Our helper became management. We needed someone who could count actual money.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Next week, the house needs new rules. Should Luna lead the house, or should Dino keep control? Tell us below.
